en.cta: Replace this study with your own film.
en.note: A drawing study, not a finished product ad

shots.action: Two separate objects drift toward each other but cannot connect

shots.purpose: Introduce an action that changes the situation
shots.action: The left object expands into a message and travels across the gap
The message lands; a response radiates from the receiving object
The camera pulls back while the same objects form a working network

shots.purpose: Resolve the motif into the identity
shots.action: The network contracts into a mark; the wordmark takes over the frame
